summary.zh: 设计取消流程、挽留优惠与催款邮件
summary.en: Design cancel flows, save offers and dunning emails

description.zh: 围绕取消流程、挽留优惠、退出问卷和催款邮件设计留存动作，处理因扣款失败导致的被动流失，并先估算涉及的收入规模。适合退订率偏高或支付失败流失明显时使用。
description.en: Designs cancel flows, save offers, exit surveys and dunning emails, and reduces involuntary churn from failed payments, starting with a revenue estimate. Use it when cancellations climb or payments fail.
